theory.title: Repaso integrado: preferencias, medios, producción y especulación
theory.explanation: Este punto de control repasa los contenidos de la Unidad 6 y no introduce gramática nueva. Combina so/neither para mostrar acuerdo, make/let/allow, be/get used to, preferencias, intensificadores, conectores narrativos, infinitivos y gerundios pasivos, modales de deducción y expresiones de probabilidad.
theory.tip: Usa el auxiliar correcto para coincidir, la forma verbal adecuada tras cada verbo y expresiones precisas para hablar de probabilidad.

content.passage: The media club recently produced a short documentary. Initially, the students were nervous, but eventually they became used to working with cameras. The teacher let them choose the topic and encouraged them to interview local residents. The final film needs to be edited before it can be shared. One student thinks it is bound to attract attention, while another believes it is unlikely to become popular immediately. They all agree that the experience was extremely useful.

items.prompt: Summarise a documentary you enjoy and agree with a partner.
items.modelAnswer: I enjoy documentaries about nature because they show how animals adapt to changing environments. I agree with my friend that they are educational, and I also like the way good presenters explain difficult ideas in simple language.

items.prompt: Explain what a teacher lets students do in a media project.
items.modelAnswer: Our teacher lets us choose a topic for the media project, but she makes us check every source before using it. She also allows us to work in pairs, which makes it easier to share research and editing.

items.prompt: Describe a technology you are used to using.
items.modelAnswer: I'm used to using a smartphone for maps, messages and banking. I still prefer a computer for long documents, but my phone is useful when I am travelling or need information quickly.

items.prompt: Say what you would rather watch and explain why.
items.modelAnswer: I would rather watch a comedy because it helps me relax after work. I prefer films with believable characters and clever dialogue to stories that depend only on special effects.

The documentary was absolutely fascinating and quite moving. It was extremely well organised, although one section was rather technical. I would recommend it to anyone interested in science and the environment.

items.prompt: Tell a short story using narrative linkers.
items.modelAnswer: First, we arrived at the theatre and found our seats. Shortly afterwards, the lights went down, but the show was delayed because of a technical problem. Meanwhile, the staff helped the audience, and eventually the performance began.

items.prompt: Explain what needs to be done before a film is published.
items.modelAnswer: Before a film is published, the editors need to check the final cut, sound levels, subtitles and credits. The producer should also confirm that music and images have permission to be used.

items.prompt: Make a deduction about a rumour using might or can't.
items.modelAnswer: The rumour might be true, but there is not enough evidence to confirm it. The person in the photograph could be a member of the team, but we cannot identify their role from the image alone. We should wait for reliable information.

items.prompt: Predict whether a new series is likely to become popular.
items.modelAnswer: I think the new series is likely to become popular because it has a strong cast and an unusual subject. If the first episodes receive good reviews, more viewers will probably watch it.

items.prompt: Review the most useful language from this unit.
items.modelAnswer: This unit has helped me discuss programmes, express agreement and explain preferences. I've also practised telling stories in order, making deductions and talking about media trends. I feel more confident giving opinions about entertainment.

A: I read a positive review online. B: Was it from a reliable source? A: Yes, although there was one advertisement during the break. B: I watched it on a streaming service. A: What's your opinion of the series? B: It's a very interesting programme.
